_comment: Editorial content for ASHT. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility was available, and a generic stock photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Ashfaq Textile Mills Limited is a public limited, quoted company established in 1988 that manufactures and sells woven fabrics. Its mill runs 243 Sulzer shuttleless looms under one roof of about 200,000 square feet in Faisalabad, and it also provides sizing and conversion services.
headOffice: 8-A, Officers Colony No. 1, Susan Road, Faisalabad, Pakistan
